The `genaisketch` connector reads GenAI spans and produces request and token
counters, missing-usage counters, and estimated distinct activity for Prometheus.
It also writes keyed top-k rankings to collector snapshot logs and, when enabled,
mergeable window summaries to files. Users, sessions, and prompt identities stay
out of metric labels.

This external component ships in this repository's
[collector image and Helm chart](../../README.md#install), or as a standalone
module for custom Collector Builder distributions. Snapshot logs and summary
files are additional outputs, not separate supported pipeline types.

## Configuration

Place `genaisketch` in `connectors`, then use it as an exporter in a traces pipeline
and a receiver in a metrics pipeline. To preserve your existing trace backend,
keep its exporter alongside `genaisketch` in the traces pipeline.

The hashing secret is required at startup. Set `GENAI_SKETCH_SECRET` to a secret
with at least 128 bits of entropy and at least 16 bytes; keep it out of source
control and configuration files. Hashes are keyed and pseudonymous.

| Setting | Default | Purpose |
| --- | --- | --- |
| `window_duration` | `1m` | Measurement window duration |
| `retention_windows` | `10` | Number of windows held in memory |
| `max_slices` | `2000` | Maximum retained slice states; excess values share an overflow bucket |
| `topk` | `20` | Maximum entries per ranking; `0` disables rankings |
| `topk_keys` | `prompt_key`, weighted by tokens | Fields to rank; users and sessions are opt-in |
| `hashing.secret_env` | `GENAI_SKETCH_SECRET` | Environment variable holding the hashing secret |
| `operation_filter.llm_operations` | `chat`, `generate_content`, `text_completion`, `embeddings` | Model operations included in accounting |
| `summary_export.enabled` | `false` | Write mergeable summary files |

Use low-cardinality, non-sensitive attributes for `slices`. The full
[configuration reference](../../docs/CONFIGURATION.md) covers field precedence,
profiles, deduplication, and MCP settings. See
[top-k keys](../../docs/TOPK_KEYS.md) for ranking options and
[summary exchange](../../docs/SUMMARY_EXCHANGE.md) for file export.

## Example

This configuration uses the components in the released collector image. It
accepts local OTLP traffic, forwards the original spans to your existing backend,
and exposes Prometheus metrics on `127.0.0.1:8889`. Set
`EXISTING_OTLP_GRPC_ENDPOINT` to your backend's TLS-enabled OTLP/gRPC endpoint and
provide `GENAI_SKETCH_SECRET` before starting the collector.

```yaml
receivers:
  otlp:
    protocols:
      grpc:
        endpoint: 127.0.0.1:4317
      http:
        endpoint: 127.0.0.1:4318

processors:
  batch:
    timeout: 1s

connectors:
  genaisketch:
    window_duration: 1m
    retention_windows: 10
    max_slices: 2000
    topk: 20
    hashing:
      algo: hmac_sha256_64
      secret_env: GENAI_SKETCH_SECRET
    operation_filter:
      llm_operations: [chat, generate_content, text_completion, embeddings]
    slices:
      - name: model
        keys: [gen_ai.request.model]
        from_resource_attributes: [gen_ai.request.model]
    topk_keys:
      - field: prompt_key
        weight: tokens
      - field: user_key
        weight: tokens
      - field: session_key
        weight: tokens

exporters:
  otlp_grpc/existing:
    endpoint: ${env:EXISTING_OTLP_GRPC_ENDPOINT}
  prometheus:
    endpoint: 127.0.0.1:8889
    translation_strategy: UnderscoreEscapingWithoutSuffixes

service:
  pipelines:
    traces:
      receivers: [otlp]
      processors: [batch]
      exporters: [genaisketch, otlp_grpc/existing]
    metrics:
      receivers: [genaisketch]
      exporters: [prometheus]
```

User rankings read `enduser.id` or `user.id`; session rankings read
`gen_ai.conversation.id` or `session.id` on each model span. Map these fields to
your instrumentation using the [field mapping guide](../../docs/CONFIGURATION.md#field-mapping).
See [shadow mode](../../docs/SHADOW_MODE.md) for deployment-ready fan-out recipes.

## Measurement Semantics

The connector counts model attempts separately from agent, tool, retrieval, and
MCP spans. Missing usage is counted explicitly; cache tokens are subsets of
input tokens, and reasoning tokens are a subset of output tokens. Distinct
counts are estimates, and rankings carry lower and upper bounds. Original spans
remain subject to your trace backend's content and retention policy.

The [metrics reference](../../docs/METRICS.md) lists the emitted instruments.
[Accounting](../../docs/ACCOUNTING.md) defines token validity, window timing,
and restart behavior. Use exact records for billing and quota enforcement.

## Maintaining The Status Header

`metadata.yaml` follows the current contrib connector format, including its
separate supported-pipeline table. The reference is the
[Count Connector](https://github.com/open-telemetry/opentelemetry-collector-contrib/tree/a42af6edafc0249a6a95237dac4c64dbf8db716c/connector/countconnector).

Regenerate from this directory with the same `mdatagen` version used by that
contrib revision. Generate in a temporary directory so its generated Go files
do not enter this component. The final substitution links our external
distribution, which upstream's distribution-link map does not include.

```sh
(
set -eu
scratch=$(mktemp -d)
trap 'rm -rf "$scratch"' EXIT
mkdir "$scratch/genaisketchconnector" "$scratch/tool"
cp go.mod go.sum factory.go metadata.yaml README.md "$scratch/genaisketchconnector/"
(
  cd "$scratch/tool"
  export GOWORK=off
  go mod init status-generator
  go get go.opentelemetry.io/collector/cmd/mdatagen@v0.162.1-0.20261006173156-20487f801913 \
    go.opentelemetry.io/collector/internal/schemagen@v0.162.1-0.20261006173156-20487f801913
  go build -o ../mdatagen go.opentelemetry.io/collector/cmd/mdatagen
)
(
  cd "$scratch/genaisketchconnector"
  GOWORK=off ../mdatagen metadata.yaml
)
sed 's|^\[otelcol-genai-sketches\]:.*$|[otelcol-genai-sketches]: https://github.com/llm-measurement/otelcol-genai-sketches#install|' \
  "$scratch/genaisketchconnector/README.md" > README.md
)
```
